name: LittleBite
subtitle: Baby solids & allergen tracker
promotionalText: Log every try, watch for reactions and introduce your baby to 100 foods with confidence. Export the diary to PDF for your pediatrician.
description:
LittleBite is a simple baby food diary for parents. Log every try, keep an eye on reactions and calmly introduce your little one to new foods.

What's inside:

• Food diary. Food, amount, meal and reaction — logged in a couple of taps. All tries by day; edit or delete any of them.

• Foods are introduced in series. The app counts tries and shows the status: "trying", "introduced", "had a reaction". Foods with reactions and allergens get their own "Needs attention" block.

• A hint on what to try next. We take into account your baby's age, foods already introduced, known allergies and eczema. We'll suggest continuing a series or taking a break after a reaction.

• Food catalog: vegetables, fruit, grains, meat, fish and more — with descriptions, first-serving tips and allergen labels. Add your own foods with a photo.

• Marks "Already introduced", "Allergy", "Exclude" and favorites for the foods your baby loves.

• PDF for the doctor: all tries, reactions and food statuses in one file — save it or send it to your pediatrician.

• The path to 100 foods: progress right on the home screen.

• Several children: each has their own profile, photo and diary.

• Reminders to continue a series the next day — no night-time notifications.

• No sign-up required. Start right away and link your email whenever you like.

Your diary and photos stay on your phone: your child's name, entries and reactions are not sent to a server.

The app does not replace medical advice. If your baby has an allergy or you are unsure how to introduce a food, talk to your pediatrician.
